Cc: Procurement <procurement@luminarix.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:14:00 +0100
Subject: Luminarix MAP starter + evaluation runway (initial draft)

Hi Lara / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised I attached a compact MAP starter doc and a short slide set I call the "Evaluation Runway" — the goal is a crisp week-by-week acceptance plan so your team can see exactly what success looks like for a 30–90 day pilot.

Quick highlights in the attached draft:
- Week 0: sandbox access, privacy/security kickoff, success criteria alignment.
- Weeks 1–4: integration + sample-run evaluation (core metrics, latency targets).
- Weeks 5–8: scale validation, edge-case scenarios, quality accept/reject gates.
- Final 30/60/90 acceptance matrix and signoff owners.

Ask: can you confirm the primary technical lead and procurement contact you want on the doc? If you'd like, we can tailor the week-by-week milestones to align with your internal blackout dates.

Attachments: Luminarix-MAP-starter-compact.gdoc, Evaluation-Runway-week0-12-slides.pptx, Luminarix-security-questionnaire.pdf

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll coauthor the MAP with your leads this week.
2) Schedule a 60-min technical workshop (we can do Wed/Thu next week).
3) Procurement review of the security questionnaire + initial commercial terms.

Looking forward —
Olga

Hi Olga —

Thanks for this, the structure looks promising. A couple of quick asks before we co-author:

- Can you shorten the Week 0 activities to two items? Our infra freeze starts next Monday and we need clarity on minimal access required.
- Procurement will need SOC 2 / data flow diagrams. We started the attached questionnaire but would like any artifacts you can share (SOC 2 cert or interim report).
- Our technical lead will be Tom Blake (cc'ed). Procurement is included.

If you can update the MAP to show a minimal Week 0 (access + security sync), I think we can get internal approvals faster. Also, are you able to run the initial technical workshop remotely in CET morning hours?

Best,
Lara
